state_history:
0: INIT -> OPEN_DEVICE | open VM vim2m video node
1: OPEN_DEVICE -> QUERYCAP | VIDIOC_QUERYCAP and capability gate
2: QUERYCAP -> FORMAT_NEGOTIATION | real VIDIOC_S_FMT on OUTPUT and CAPTURE queues
3: FORMAT_NEGOTIATION -> BUFFER_SETUP | real REQBUFS, QUERYBUF and mmap on both queues
4: BUFFER_SETUP -> STREAMING | real VIDIOC_STREAMON on CAPTURE then OUTPUT
5: STREAMING -> RUNNING | real poll, DQBUF and requeue loop on vim2m
6: RUNNING -> RECOVERY | real STREAMOFF, requeue and STREAMON after timeout probe
7: RECOVERY -> RUNNING | return after timeout recovery
8: RUNNING -> DRAINING | vim2m has no codec EOS; record drain boundary then stop queues
9: DRAINING -> STOPPED | STREAMOFF, munmap, REQBUFS count=0 and close finished
